text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
Mortal, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
text_cn: “人子，你要面向色依尔山，讲预言攻斥它，

text_en: and say to it, Thus says the Lord God : I am against you, Mount Seir; I stretch out my hand against you to make you a desolation and a waste.
text_cn: 对它说：吾主上主这样说：色依尔山啊！看，我要攻击你，伸手打击你，使你变成沙漠和荒野。

text_en: I lay your towns in ruins; you shall become a desolation, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要使你的城市变成废墟，你将成为沙漠：如此，你便承认我是上主。

text_en: Because you cherished an ancient enmity, and gave over the people of Israel to the power of the sword at the time of their calamity, at the time of their final punishment;
text_cn: 因为在以色列子民遭难时，在他们罪恶满盈时，你怀着永不忘的仇恨将他们交于刀剑：

text_en: therefore, as I live, says the Lord God , I will prepare you for blood, and blood shall pursue you; since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed shall pursue you.
text_cn: 为此，我指着我的生命起誓 —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 你既仇恨了血，血也必迫害你。

text_en: I will make Mount Seir a waste and a desolation; and I will cut off from it all who come and go.
text_cn: 我必使色依尔山成为沙漠和荒野，由其中灭绝来往经过的人。

text_en: I will fill its mountains with the slain; on your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses those killed with the sword shall fall.
text_cn: 我要使你的群山、丘陵、山谷和溪涧，堆满伤亡的人，使刀剑伤亡的人横卧其中。

text_en: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities shall never be inhabited. Then you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要使你永久变为荒芜，你的城邑再没有人居住：如此，你们便承认我是上主。

text_en: Because you said, “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will take possession of them, ”—although the Lord was there—
text_cn: 因为你说过：这两个民族，这两个地域应属于我， 虽然雅威住在那里，我还要去占领；

text_en: therefore, as I live, says the Lord God , I will deal with you according to the anger and envy that you showed because of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among you, when I judge you.
text_cn: 为此，我指着我的生命起誓， —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 就如你怎样怀着仇恨对待他们，同样我也必以怒火和妒恨来对待你；当我惩罚你时，我叫你知道我在他们中，

text_en: You shall know that I, the Lord , have heard all the abusive speech that you uttered against the mountains of Israel, saying, “They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour. ”
text_cn: 并要你知道，我上主听见了你向以色列的群山所讲的一切诅咒的话，说：它们已荒芜了，已交给我们享用。

text_en: And you magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and multiplied your words against me; I heard it.
text_cn: 当你们开口说大话攻斥我，说出许多凌辱我的话时，我都听见了。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : As the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：当全地欢跃时，我要使你荒芜，

text_en: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so I will deal with you; you shall be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 就如在以色列家的产业荒芜时，你曾喜乐；同样，我也要这样对待你；色依尔山必变成荒野，全厄东必被消灭：如此，人必承认我是上主。”
